g.text: 21 normal test flights, every 10th complete log row. A multirotor does not have to point where it flies: below about 5 m/s and in turns its course and heading differ by 20-100 deg with honest GPS. A slow drift turns

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: the GPS course by only a few degrees, which hides in that spread, so the course channel never separates attacks (see R09_consistency_channels).
